threat_event: Attacker uses a compromised integrator account on the remote access gateway to reach PLT-01 engineering workstations and changes ammonia unit alarm limits and setpoints
threat_source: Nation-state or cybercriminal group targeting chemical OT
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Three integrator accounts on the gateway were shared by several integrator staff (P07 AC-2); no SIEM alert on alarm limit changes on safety-relevant tags (POAM-022)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 GC-PCBMS; ammonia unit (P05 BP-02, BP-03)
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R02 (101.650(a)(6)); C-CHEMICAL-R02 (101.650(f)(3)); 40 CFR 68.67; C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark)
existing_controls: Central gateway with MFA, per-session approval, and recording; independent Ammonia Unit SIS; download requires on-site engineer
treatment_plan: Disable shared integrator accounts and issue named accounts (POAM-005); SIEM alerts on alarm limit and SIS keyswitch changes (POAM-022); add the scenario to the ammonia unit PHA revalidation
key_risk_indicator: Shared accounts on the gateway; unapproved remote sessions; alarm limit changes without MOC

threat_event: Ransomware compromises enterprise IT and spreads through shared OT services (gateway, vault, patch staging) to several plants at once
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared OT services serve 11 plants; enterprise-wide restore of OT never exercised; acquired plants on flat networks (R-010)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02, SYS-03; all plant production (P05 BP-01, BP-05, BP-18)
sp800_53_controls: SC-7; SI-3; SI-4; CP-9; CP-10; IR-4
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R02 (101.650(h)(1)); C-CHEMICAL-R02 (101.650(g)(4)); SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05; 17 CFR 229.106
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC with OT analysts; OT DMZs at 10 plants; immutable IT backups; offline OT vault copies; cyber insurance
treatment_plan: Separate administrative tiers for the gateway and vault; second offline vault copy not reachable from the enterprise domain; enterprise OT ransomware exercise with the disclosure committee (POAM-004); OT restore tests (POAM-003)
key_risk_indicator: Plants recoverable from the vault within RTO; EDR and allowlisting coverage on OT hosts

threat_event: A safety instrumented system program is altered, or differs from the approved copy, and the safety function fails on demand
threat_source: Insider, integrator, or attacker with engineering access; or an unreviewed change
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Comparison of running SIS programs with approved copies is manual and irregular (last done 2025-11); SIS engineering software on 2 EWS
affected_asset_or_process: Ammonia Unit SIS; Chlor Unit SIS; SIS at PLT-04 and PLT-05 (P05 BP-02)
existing_controls: Keyswitch control; two-person SIS change rule; proof tests on schedule; approved copies in the vault
treatment_plan: Monthly comparison now (manual) and automated comparison by 2027-01-31 (POAM-009); remove SIS software from general EWS
key_risk_indicator: Days since last SIS program comparison; mismatches found

threat_event: Control logic, alarm limits, or recipes are changed outside management of change and create an unsafe or off-spec condition
threat_source: Operators, engineers, or integrators under schedule pressure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 7 of 40 sampled PLT-01 DCS changes had no MOC record; same pattern at 5 other plants
existing_controls: Electronic MOC system; DCS role levels; audit trail
treatment_plan: Weekly reconciliation of DCS change logs to MOC records; automated configuration comparison (POAM-001); MOC training for controls engineers
owner: Vice President, Process Safety and EHS
key_risk_indicator: DCS changes without MOC per month

threat_event: Attacker exploits a known exploited vulnerability on a PLT-01 OT host in the OT DMZ or supervisory network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 37 KEV findings on PLT-01 OT assets older than 30 days without documented compensating controls
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 OT DMZ and supervisory network
existing_controls: Quarterly patch windows; OT DMZ segmentation; passive monitoring
treatment_plan: Document compensating controls for every open KEV by 2026-10-31; KEV triage within 7 days; patch at planned outages (POAM-002)
key_risk_indicator: Open KEVs on critical OT older than 30 days without compensating controls

threat_event: Attack on PLT-01 OT goes undetected for days because OT-specific detections are missing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No SIEM use case for alarm limit changes on safety-relevant tags or SIS keyswitch position; terminal and rack PLC networks not monitored
existing_controls: Passive OT monitoring on control and supervisory networks; SOC OT analysts
treatment_plan: Build OT use cases (POAM-022); extend monitoring to terminal and rack networks (POAM-011)
key_risk_indicator: OT use cases in production; mean time to detect in purple-team tests

threat_event: OT recovery after a destructive attack takes far longer than the 12-hour RTO because restores have not been proven
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Restore tested for 1 of 3 PLT-01 DCS areas; recovery procedures exist for the ammonia area only
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01; SYS-03 OT backup vault (P05 BP-01, BP-03)
existing_controls: Offline and immutable OT backups; on-site spares; vendor emergency support
treatment_plan: Restore tests for the Chlor Unit and blend hall areas at the 2027-02 outage; procedures for each area (POAM-003)
key_risk_indicator: DCS areas with a successful restore test in the last 12 months

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts the PLT-01 historian and OT workstations and forces the plant into a safe-state shutdown
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 9 operator stations without allowlisting (unsupported OS); USB control gaps on EWS
existing_controls: Allowlisting on servers and most stations; OT DMZ; vault backups
treatment_plan: Replace unsupported stations (POAM-020); enforce media scanning (POAM-021); restore tests (POAM-003)
key_risk_indicator: OT hosts without allowlisting or EDR

threat_event: The PLT-01 Cybersecurity Plan and Cybersecurity Assessment are not ready for the Coast Guard by 2027-07-16
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Assessment and plan not started in full; approved list and network map incomplete
affected_asset_or_process: PLT-01 MTSA facility (marine terminal and BP-04)
existing_controls: CySO designated; training largely complete; Facility Security Plan approved
treatment_plan: Complete the Cybersecurity Assessment by 2027-01-31 and submit the plan by 2027-03-31 (POAM-008; POAM-006)

threat_event: Attacker enters an acquired plant through its flat IT/OT network and stops production or reaches enterprise systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PLT-12 to PLT-14 have flat networks, shared DCS and PLC accounts, no OT monitoring, and local untested backups
affected_asset_or_process: PLT-12 to PLT-14 OT and IT (P05 BP-18, BP-09)
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); C-CHEMICAL-R02 (101.650(h)(1)) (benchmark only; these plants are not MTSA facilities)
existing_controls: Site firewalls toward the enterprise; EDR on IT endpoints
treatment_plan: OT DMZ and segmentation at each plant; named accounts; onboard to the vault (POAM-015)
key_risk_indicator: Acquired plants with an OT DMZ; acquired plants backing up to the vault

threat_event: An integrator remote tool outside the central gateway at an acquired plant is used to take control of plant OT
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Three legacy integrators use always-on remote tools at PLT-12 to PLT-14; connections not monitored
affected_asset_or_process: PLT-12 to PLT-14 DCS and PLCs
existing_controls: Integrator contracts (legacy)
treatment_plan: Disable remote tools except supervised call-in until the gateway is extended (POAM-014)
key_risk_indicator: Remote tools found outside the gateway

threat_event: A material OT incident is disclosed late or inaccurately because the materiality process was designed for data breaches
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Materiality playbook covers data breaches only; disclosure committee has no operations or process safety member; never exercised an OT scenario
existing_controls: Disclosure committee chaired by the General Counsel; outside securities counsel
treatment_plan: Add OT materiality factors (production days lost, safety, regulatory) and operations members; OT tabletop on 2026-11-12 (POAM-004)
key_risk_indicator: Disclosure exercises with an OT scenario in the last 12 months

threat_event: An OT vendor or integrator is compromised and its access or software is used against company plants
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 of 6 integrators have no security clauses; DCS vendor support contract lacks a vulnerability and incident notification clause
existing_controls: Tiered vendor reviews; gateway for vendor access
treatment_plan: Contract amendments at renewal with notification and security clauses (POAM-010); supplier assessments for all 6 integrators
key_risk_indicator: OT suppliers with security and notification clauses

threat_event: Default vendor passwords on the terminal tank gauging server and truck rack PLC web interfaces are used to change tank levels or rack settings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default passwords found during P07 testing (new finding 2026-08-12)
affected_asset_or_process: Terminal automation; truck rack PLCs (P05 BP-04, BP-07)
existing_controls: Zone firewall around terminal network
treatment_plan: Change all default passwords and sweep all PLT-01 PLCs (POAM-013)

threat_event: An untrained contractor causes or misses a cyber incident at the PLT-01 terminal or plant
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 212 contractor personnel missed the MTSA cybersecurity training deadline and are escorted instead
existing_controls: Escort and monitoring by trained staff
treatment_plan: Contractor training before badge renewal (POAM-007)

threat_event: A disgruntled insider with engineering rights changes recipes or control logic to cause damage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Engineering rights held by 22 people; insider monitoring limited in OT
existing_controls: Two-person recipe approval; background checks; audit trail
treatment_plan: Quarterly review of engineering actions; insider indicators shared with Corporate Security

threat_event: Hydrogen peroxide (50%) is diverted by manipulating inventory or shipment records
threat_source: Criminal or terrorist actor, possibly with insider help
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Inventory adjustments in the ERP reviewed quarterly only
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-05 ERP; tank farms at 9 plants
existing_controls: Legacy CFATS Site Security Plan measures kept; tank level reconciliation
treatment_plan: Monthly reconciliation of hydrogen peroxide inventory to tank levels; alert on manual adjustments

threat_event: Formulations and process know-how are stolen from file shares, the data platform, or engineering systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Formulations spread across file shares and plant systems; data loss prevention tuned for SSI and personal data first
affected_asset_or_process: R&D centers; data platform; batch systems
existing_controls: Data classification POL-04; DLP on email and web
treatment_plan: Restricted label for formulations; DLP rules; access review of R&D shares

threat_event: A toll customer sees another customer's batch records or recipe data in the SL-2 portal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tenant isolation is enforced in application logic
existing_controls: Release testing of tenant isolation; MFA
treatment_plan: Annual penetration test of the portal; automated isolation tests in the pipeline

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects a supplier or customer payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 2,600 vendors; bank detail changes by email
existing_controls: Call-back verification; MFA; email authentication
treatment_plan: Vendor master change workflow with independent verification
key_risk_indicator: Bank change requests verified by call-back

threat_event: During a release, emergency notification fails because the VoIP phones run on the business network that is down or compromised
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: At 9 plants the notification path depends on VoIP on the business network; kits only at PLT-01, PLT-04, PLT-05
existing_controls: Cellular phones and radios at three plants; mass notification service
treatment_plan: Issue notification kits to the 11 other plants and test each quarter (POAM-017)
owner: Vice President, Process Safety and EHS
key_risk_indicator: Plants with a tested independent notification path

threat_event: False tank levels from the SL-1 telemetry platform cause wrong replenishment, overfill, or a water utility running out of treatment chemicals
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 1,400 automatic replenishment orders a week flow into the ERP
existing_controls: Order validation against site limits; device certificates
treatment_plan: Anomaly detection on level changes; daily review of critical water utility sites
key_risk_indicator: Orders blocked by validation; level anomalies

threat_event: Telemetry sensor credentials are cloned and used to inject data or reach the platform
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 41,000 field devices at customer sites
existing_controls: Unique device certificates; revocation
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low residual; device certificate rotation at hardware refresh

threat_event: Hazmat shipment routes and status in the TMS and telematics are used to target a shipment en route
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: TMS and telematics are not in the DOT security plan risk assessment
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-11 TMS and telematics (P05 BP-06, BP-07)
existing_controls: Role-based access; carrier contract security requirements
treatment_plan: Add the TMS and telematics to the DOT security plan risk assessment at the 2026 annual review (POAM-018)
key_risk_indicator: Security plan review completed on time

threat_event: Operators accept a wrong advisory setpoint from AI-001 and the batch goes off-spec or the margin to a safe limit shrinks
threat_source: Model drift or data quality failure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Advisory setpoints at 6 plants; drift monitoring started 2026-06
existing_controls: Advisory only; setpoint bounds; operators enter changes by hand
treatment_plan: Drift thresholds with automatic suspension; operator guidance (P10)
key_risk_indicator: Advisory setpoints rejected by bounds; drift alerts

threat_event: A closed-loop AI-001 pilot creates a write path from the cloud into the PLT-01 DCS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Closed-loop pilot proposed for PLT-01
existing_controls: One-way architecture rule (P04)
treatment_plan: Pilot not approved; any future proposal needs MOC, PHA, and an on-premises design with no cloud write path (P10)
key_risk_indicator: Write paths from cloud to OT (target 0)

threat_event: Staff paste formulations or SSI into an unapproved generative AI service
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shadow AI use observed in 2025 web logs
existing_controls: Approved enterprise AI assistant; web filtering
treatment_plan: Unapproved generative AI domains blocked; approved assistant with no training on company data (POL-05)

threat_event: AI use cases operate without committee review and introduce unmanaged risk
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 4 of 12 use cases not yet reviewed
existing_controls: AI governance committee formed 2025
treatment_plan: Complete the 4 reviews by 2026-11-30 (POAM-019)

threat_event: A major hurricane affects PLT-01 and DC-1 at the same time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PLT-01 and DC-1 are both in Florida
existing_controls: Hurricane plan; generators; DC-2 alternate; volume transfer
treatment_plan: Property and business interruption insurance; hurricane drill each June

threat_event: Malicious code arrives in a DCS vendor patch or software update
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Patch hashes verified for the DCS vendor only since 2026-03
existing_controls: Patch staging service; vendor qualification; simulator testing
treatment_plan: Hash verification for all OT vendors; staged rollout starting with one plant

threat_event: An attacker exploits the unsupported operating system on the 9 Blend Hall 1 operator stations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Unsupported OS until the 2027 console upgrade
existing_controls: Network isolation; monitoring
treatment_plan: Console upgrade in 2027 (POAM-020)

threat_event: Malware is brought into an engineering workstation on unscanned removable media
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 4 of 6 EWS accepted an unscanned USB device in P07 testing
existing_controls: Media kiosk; USB disabled on operator stations
treatment_plan: Enforce device control on EWS (POAM-021)

threat_event: An intruder gains physical access to a control room or rack room
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large sites with contractors
existing_controls: Badge and TWIC readers; video; staffed control rooms
treatment_plan: Accepted at current level; reviewed with Facility Security Plan audit

threat_event: Firewall rules between the business network and the PLT-01 OT DMZ drift and allow an unintended path
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 14 of 212 OT DMZ rules broader than documented or unused
existing_controls: Annual firewall review
treatment_plan: Remove or narrow the 14 rules; quarterly review (POAM-012)
key_risk_indicator: Rules without a documented owner and purpose

threat_event: An OT attack at a plant whose OT logs do not reach the SIEM is not detected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT logs from PLT-08 and PLT-11 to PLT-14 not in the SIEM
existing_controls: Local logs; EDR on IT endpoints
treatment_plan: Extend log forwarding and monitoring (POAM-011)
key_risk_indicator: Plants with OT logs in the SIEM

threat_event: A former employee or contractor uses a DCS account that was not removed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 of 25 sampled leavers still had enabled DCS accounts
existing_controls: Badge removal stops site entry; gateway accounts removed automatically
treatment_plan: Automated leaver ticket with 24-hour SLA and weekly reconciliation (POAM-023)

threat_event: A phishing campaign steals an engineer's enterprise credentials and session tokens
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Engineers use email and the gateway from the same laptop
existing_controls: Phishing-resistant MFA for privileged and remote OT access; email filtering
treatment_plan: Dedicated access devices for OT remote access users by 2027-06-30
key_risk_indicator: Phishing simulation failure rate for engineers

threat_event: A zero-day in an internet-facing edge device (VPN or firewall) is exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Edge devices at 40 sites
existing_controls: Emergency patch process; SOC monitoring
treatment_plan: Emergency patch SLA 72 h; reduce edge footprint with the SD-WAN refresh
key_risk_indicator: Edge devices patched within 72 h of KEV listing

threat_event: An identity platform outage blocks all IT access and remote OT engineering
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single identity platform
existing_controls: Break-glass accounts; secondary region; OT local logon independent by design
treatment_plan: Accepted; tested annually in DR
owner: Director of Identity and Access Management

threat_event: An ERP SaaS outage stops order to ship and hazmat shipping documentation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single ERP instance
existing_controls: Contract RTO 8 h; manual bills of lading and printed shipping papers
treatment_plan: Quarterly manual shipping drill at the 4 largest plants

threat_event: A LIMS outage holds shipments because certificates of analysis cannot be issued
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single LIMS instance with warm standby
existing_controls: Warm standby; paper fallback
treatment_plan: Accepted; DR met RTO in 2026

threat_event: An outage of a cloud provider region affects the LIMS, data platform, or SL-1
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Regional dependencies
existing_controls: Second-region standby for tier-1 workloads
treatment_plan: Accepted

threat_event: SSI about the PLT-01 terminal (network maps, plan drafts) is disclosed through the data platform or file shares
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Cybersecurity Plan drafts in progress; SSI labeling new
existing_controls: SSI handling procedure; DLP label
treatment_plan: SSI repository with restricted access for plan drafts
key_risk_indicator: SSI documents outside the SSI repository

threat_event: Employee personal data is breached at the HR and payroll SaaS provider
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 12,000 current and former employees
regulatory_driver: State breach laws (Fla. Stat. 501.171 worked example)
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 review; breach clause
treatment_plan: Cyber insurance; vendor notification clause aligned with state law

threat_event: A SOX IT general control fails in the ERP (access or change)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large ERP user base; acquired plants on a legacy ERP
existing_controls: Quarterly SOX ITGC testing
treatment_plan: Migrate acquired plants to the ERP by 2027-03-31

threat_event: The legacy ERP at the acquired plants allows unreviewed inventory and financial changes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PLT-12 to PLT-14 ship from their legacy ERP until 2027-03-31
existing_controls: Compensating monthly reviews
treatment_plan: ERP migration (2027-03-31)
key_risk_indicator: Manual journal entries at acquired plants

threat_event: An outage at the cellular carrier that serves about 80% of telemetry sensors stops SL-1 data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single carrier for most sensors
existing_controls: Dual-SIM on 20% of sensors; customers can phone in orders
treatment_plan: Dual-SIM sensors at contract renewal, starting with water utilities

threat_event: The MOC and PSM records SaaS is unavailable and the paper fallback fails
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Paper fallback never exercised
existing_controls: Paper MOC forms
treatment_plan: Exercise the paper fallback at one plant per quarter
owner: Vice President, Process Safety and EHS

threat_event: SDSs cannot be delivered to customers and carriers during an outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SDS authoring SaaS
existing_controls: Static SDS mirror; emergency response provider copy
treatment_plan: Accepted

threat_event: Hazmat shipping papers are altered in the ERP so a shipment carries wrong emergency response information
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shipping paper templates editable by logistics administrators
regulatory_driver: 49 CFR 172 subpart C and subpart G
existing_controls: Template change control; carrier checks
treatment_plan: Change alert on shipping paper templates

threat_event: Loading rack automation is manipulated and causes an overfill or misload of a hazmat cargo tank
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Rack PLCs per plant; default passwords found at PLT-01 (R-014)
existing_controls: Ground and overfill interlocks independent of the PLC at the 4 largest racks
treatment_plan: Extend independent overfill interlocks to all racks

threat_event: Terminal automation is manipulated during a barge transfer and causes an overfill or spill
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tank gauging default password (R-014); terminal network not monitored
existing_controls: Independent terminal emergency shutdown; manned transfers
treatment_plan: Monitoring of terminal network (POAM-011); default password fix (POAM-013)

threat_event: A ransom payment is made to a sanctioned party
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No pre-agreed decision path for OT extortion
existing_controls: P08 requires OFAC screening and legal approval before any payment
treatment_plan: Ransom decision protocol in P08; outside counsel retained

threat_event: Loss of key OT security and controls engineering staff stalls the program
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT Center of Excellence has 12 staff; few controls engineers know the SIS
existing_controls: Cross-training; vendor support
treatment_plan: Succession plan for the CySO and SIS engineers

threat_event: EAR-controlled technology is released to an unauthorized foreign person through shared data platforms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Global sales and R&D share analytics workspaces
existing_controls: Export compliance screening; Restricted label
treatment_plan: Tag EAR-controlled technology and restrict workspaces

threat_event: Legacy CVI records from the CFATS program are mishandled
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CFATS lapsed; CVI handling no longer enforced
existing_controls: CVI kept in restricted repository
treatment_plan: Accepted; protected as Restricted

threat_event: A release during a cyber incident is reported late because responders focus on the cyber response
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Release reporting and cyber response run by different teams
existing_controls: Plant incident commander owns release reporting
treatment_plan: Single incident command with a release reporting checklist (P08)
owner: Vice President, Process Safety and EHS

threat_event: The CIRCIA final rule adds reporting duties the incident process is not ready for
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Proposed rule only
existing_controls: Regulatory watch by the Chief Compliance Officer
treatment_plan: Accepted; reassess when a final rule is published

threat_event: A future acquisition brings unassessed OT into the enterprise
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 acquisitions in 2025 integrated without OT due diligence
existing_controls: IT due diligence checklist
treatment_plan: OT due diligence and integration funding required in deal approvals

threat_event: Shared DCS and PLC accounts at the acquired plants prevent attribution of changes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared accounts at PLT-12 to PLT-14
existing_controls: Physical access control
treatment_plan: Named accounts as part of integration (POAM-015)

threat_event: Toll customer recipes are lost or corrupted and cannot be restored from a trusted copy
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Recipes stored only in plant batch systems; no separate recipe vault
affected_asset_or_process: Batch systems at 4 SL-2 plants (P05 BP-11)
existing_controls: Batch database backups
treatment_plan: Separate recipe vault with integrity checks (POAM-016)

threat_event: A DDoS attack disrupts the SL-1 or SL-2 customer portals
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Internet-facing portals
existing_controls: Provider DDoS protection; WAF
treatment_plan: Accepted

threat_event: A coordinated physical and cyber attack targets the PLT-01 marine terminal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Waterfront site with barge traffic
existing_controls: Facility Security Plan; MARSEC measures; terminal emergency shutdown
treatment_plan: Blended scenario in the 2027 MTSA exercise (101.635(c))

threat_event: Lack of OT security metrics hides deterioration from the board
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT metrics reported quarterly since 2026 only
existing_controls: Quarterly OT dashboard
treatment_plan: Accepted
